title: Speed at A
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for the speed at point A must be 4 m/s (or equivalent).

title: Maximum Distance
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for the maximum sliding distance must be 0.5 m (or equivalent).

title: Energy Balance on Arc
description: Important Criteria: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem to the quarter-arc, identifying gravitational potential energy loss and electric field work as the sources of kinetic energy.

title: Horizontal Work-Energy
description: Important Criteria: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem for the horizontal segment, setting initial kinetic energy equal to work done by friction and the electric field.

title: Forces on Horizontal
description: Important Criteria: Correctly identifies that the net force opposing motion on the horizontal surface is the sum of kinetic friction and the electric force.

title: Sign of Electric Work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly assigns the sign for the work done by the electric field on either segment, leading to wrong energy equations.

title: Friction Calculation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses an incorrect normal force (e.g., includes electric force) when calculating the frictional work on the horizontal surface.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Demonstrates unit analysis throughout the calculation, confirming all terms are in joules or equivalent.
